s1.syndrome_frame: Gradually enlarging painful mass in the thigh with malignant features
salient_findings: 20 × 10 cm swelling over the anterior and anterolateral aspects of the thigh
Cells with vesicular nuclei and well-delineated borders on fine-needle aspiration cytology
key_facts: 51-year-old man
Mass in the left thigh
Mass first noted 10 years previously
Painful for the past 6 months
No bone involvement on plain radiographs
MRI demonstrated a heterogeneous intramuscular mass
Lesion preserved the plane between the lesion and the neurovascular bundle
Fine-needle aspiration cytology showed sheets and clusters of monotomous cells
Cells had vesicular nuclei and well-delineated borders
Cells formed small anastomosing cords and exhibited a single-file arrangement

shortlist.label: Myxoid liposarcoma
shortlist.why_kept: Clinical and radiological findings of a gradually enlarging painful mass in the thigh with malignant features, and cytological findings of sheets and clusters of monotomous cells in a prominent myxoid stroma

shortlist.label: Myxofibrosarcoma
shortlist.why_kept: Presence of a heterogeneous intramuscular mass with preservation of the plane between the lesion and the neurovascular bundle, and cytological findings of cells with vesicular nuclei and well-delineated borders

shortlist.label: Low-grade fibromyxoid sarcoma
shortlist.why_kept: Clinical presentation of a slowly growing mass, and cytological findings of cells forming small anastomosing cords and exhibiting a single-file arrangement without significant pleomorphism

shortlist.label: Extraskeletal myxoid chondrosarcoma
shortlist.why_kept: Radiological findings of a heterogeneous intramuscular mass, and cytological findings of cells with vesicular nuclei and well-delineated borders in a prominent myxoid stroma

shortlist.label: Myxoid malignant fibrous histiocytoma
shortlist.why_kept: Clinical and radiological findings of a malignant mass, and cytological findings of cells with vesicular nuclei and well-delineated borders in a prominent myxoid stroma

raw.rationale: The presence of a heterogeneous intramuscular mass with a prominent myxoid stroma, monotomous cells with vesicular nuclei, and well-delineated borders, along with the formation of small anastomosing cords and a single-file arrangement, are characteristic features of myxoid liposarcoma.

rejected.label: Myxofibrosarcoma
rejected.why: Typically shows a higher degree of cellular pleomorphism and atypia

rejected.label: Low-grade fibromyxoid sarcoma
rejected.why: Usually exhibits a more uniform fibrous and myxoid pattern

rejected.label: Extraskeletal myxoid chondrosarcoma
rejected.why: Characterized by the presence of chondroblast-like cells and a distinct chondroid matrix

rejected.label: Myxoid malignant fibrous histiocytoma
rejected.why: No longer considered a distinct entity and is now classified under other sarcoma subtypes
